target.title: feat(openai): support gpt-realtime-2.1
target.body:
Related: #80196

## What Problem This Solves

OpenClaw's OpenAI realtime voice path still defaulted to `gpt-realtime-2`, so users did not receive the current Realtime 2.1 behavior unless they manually overrode the model.

## Why This Change Was Made

This updates the OpenAI realtime voice default, documentation, Discord configuration hints, generated metadata, and live smoke defaults to `gpt-realtime-2.1`. It also adds an `--openai-only` smoke mode so the OpenAI WebSocket and WebRTC paths can be validated without unrelated Google credentials, while keeping `gpt-realtime-2.1-mini` available as an explicit smaller, lower-cost override.

## User Impact

OpenAI realtime voice now uses `gpt-realtime-2.1` by default. Existing explicit model overrides remain unchanged, including `gpt-realtime-2`, and operators can select `gpt-realtime-2.1-mini` when they prefer the smaller model.

## Evidence

- Official OpenAI model documentation and the live `/v1/models` catalog confirmed `gpt-realtime-2.1` and `gpt-realtime-2.1-mini`.
- Focused tests: 121 passed across the OpenAI provider and live-smoke tooling suites.
- Generated bundled channel configuration metadata check passed.
- Live AWS Crabbox E2E (`run_13fcbabb703c`): `gpt-realtime-2.1` completed the backend bridge WebSocket session flow and browser WebRTC negotiation with audio, an applied remote description, and `connected` state.
- Fresh branch autoreview: no actionable findings; patch rated correct with 0.82 confidence.
- `git diff --check` passed.

AI-assisted: yes. I reviewed and understand the implementation and validation described above.
